note: Jackson County forest campground (not Wood County) about 12 miles north of Warrens, strung along the north shore of Potter Flowage under pines, with a boat launch and picnic area. ATV-accessible sites. --Claude

'Self-registration box' dropped from note (registration is online).

The engine's own site photos (https://www.jacksoncountyparks.us/parks/i/ii/l__ml_site_12.jpg, ..._2.jpg, ..._6.jpg) show open mown grass under scattered pines running down to the flowage: site 12's table sits ~20-30 m from open water across open grass with nothing between; site 2 ~30-40 m across grass and a reed fringe; site 6 ~40 m through a row of pine trunks.
